# Riverside Running Club rules

## Meetings

We run every Tuesday at 6:30pm from the boathouse. Runs last about an hour, at a pace everyone can keep.

## Fees

The yearly fee is £20, paid by bank transfer in January. Juniors under 16 run free.

## Safety

- Wear something bright after dark.
- Tell the run organiser if you turn back early.
- Headphones are allowed at low volume only.
